name: @preflight/contracts
description: Declarative tool contracts (SPEC S20): the annotation format, the CI lint that fails unannotated Tier 2/3 writes, and the coverage number. Zero runtime deps, zero installs.
//build-choice: Plain .mjs, zero dependencies of any kind — `npm test` runs from a clean checkout with
no node_modules. Same constraint discipline as @preflight/core (KICKOFF rules 6+7).
//run-model: Pure-JS (.mjs) lint tool + JSON annotation catalog — no TypeScript, nothing to compile. `build` syntax-checks the shipped tool (node --check); `lint`/`test` run the real catalog validation.
